specification.objective: Remove the unsuccessful global Firefox CPU-rendering workaround and isolate the remaining Kanban rendering defect by replacing only the horizontal column ReorderableListView with a plain horizontal ListView. Preserve the dedicated Kanban page, vertical card reordering, backend/API behavior, and all project/task functionality while reducing renderer and overlay complexity.

requirements.statement: The source tree must not provide a custom frontend/web/flutter_bootstrap.js; Flutter Web must use its generated bootstrap while frontend/web/index.html continues loading flutter_bootstrap.js.
KanbanBoardView must render columns with a plain horizontal ListView rather than a horizontal ReorderableListView.
Vertical card ordering inside non-empty columns must continue using the existing ReorderableListView and existing card movement callbacks.
ProjectKanbanPage must remain a dedicated screen with contentScrollable false; the Kanban must not be reinserted into ProjectTasksPage.
Column create, rename, delete, card CRUD, cross-column card movement, assignee management, optimistic concurrency, backend models, API routes, and persistence must remain unchanged.

Horizontal drag reordering of columns is intentionally not mounted in this isolation slice; the existing controller/API capability remains untouched for later reintroduction after rendering stability is verified.
The locked Change Contract must be versioned at docs/contracts/project-kanban-rendering-isolation-v1.polis.json.

acceptance_criteria.statement: frontend/web/flutter_bootstrap.js is absent, index.html still references flutter_bootstrap.js, and the renderer-policy regression test protects use of Flutter's generated bootstrap.
KanbanBoardView contains a horizontal ListView for columns and no horizontal ReorderableListView.
KanbanBoardView still contains exactly one ReorderableListView for card ordering in non-empty columns.
ProjectKanbanPage remains dedicated and outside the workspace's outer vertical scroll.
The payload does not modify backend, API, database, authorization, controller, or project/task management behavior.
The locked schema-v4 contract is present at docs/contracts/project-kanban-rendering-isolation-v1.polis.json.

invariants.statement: The dedicated Kanban route/page introduced previously remains in place.
No new Flutter package or drag-and-drop dependency is introduced.
Vertical card reorder and cross-column DragTarget/LongPressDraggable behavior are not rewritten in this slice.
Existing historical POLIS contracts remain versioned under docs/contracts even when superseded by this diagnostic correction.

forbidden_states.statement: canvasKitForceCpuOnly remains configured by application-owned web bootstrap code.
The horizontal Kanban column viewport is still a ReorderableListView.
The change rewrites card drag-and-drop, backend behavior, authorization, or persistence.
The Kanban is moved back into ProjectTasksPage.

inputs.statement: The published feature/tasks-kanban state at commit c4ed9c3e95a903bbf572c15fc5db9ca1cae37e39, where the dedicated Kanban page still exhibits the rendering defect and Firefox is globally forced to CanvasKit CPU-only rendering.

outputs.statement: Normal Flutter-generated web bootstrap with no application-level CPU-only renderer override.
Dedicated Kanban page whose horizontal column viewport is a plain ListView while vertical card reordering remains intact.

failure_semantics.statement: If a custom CPU-only bootstrap remains, the horizontal column ReorderableListView remains, the vertical card ReorderableListView is removed, or the dedicated page is lost, validation fails closed with project_kanban_rendering_isolation_missing.
Flutter/Dart tooling is unavailable in the artifact-production environment, so widget tests are included but must not be claimed as executed here; CI/local Flutter execution remains required.
